mapper.select: SELECT rbs.rbs_id AS resume_id, rbs.rbs_resume_name AS resume_name, rbs.rbs_job_direction AS job_direction, rbs.rbs_is_default AS is_default, ( (CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_job_direction IS NOT NULL AND rbs.rbs_job_direction != '' THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_education edu WHERE edu.edu_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_work work WHERE work.wrk_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 25 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_project project WHERE project.prj_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 25 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_skill skill WHERE skill.skl_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) ) AS completion, LEAST(99, GREATEST(60, 70 + (CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_job_direction IS NOT NULL AND pos.pos_title LIKE CONCAT('%', rbs.rbs_job_direction, '%') THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_is_default = 1 THEN 5 ELSE 0 END) )) AS match_score, CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_is_default = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS recommended, rbs.rbs_updated_at AS updated_at, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_app_record app INNER JOIN t_tal tal ON tal.tal_id = app.app_candidate_id WHERE tal.tal_user_id = #{userId} AND app.app_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id ) AS used_application_count FROM t_res_base rbs INNER JOIN t_pos pos ON pos.pos_id = #{jobId} WHERE rbs.rbs_user_id = #{userId} AND rbs.rbs_status = 1 ORDER BY recommended DESC, completion DESC, rbs.rbs_updated_at DESC

SELECT rbs.rbs_id AS resume_id, rbs.rbs_resume_name AS resume_name, rbs.rbs_job_direction AS job_direction, rbs.rbs_is_default AS is_default, ( (CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_job_direction IS NOT NULL AND rbs.rbs_job_direction != '' THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_education edu WHERE edu.edu_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 20 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_work work WHERE work.wrk_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 25 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_project project WHERE project.prj_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 25 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_res_skill skill WHERE skill.skl_resume_id = rbs.rbs_id) THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) ) AS completion, 0 AS match_score, CASE WHEN rbs.rbs_is_default = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS recommended, rbs.rbs_updated_at AS updated_at, 0 AS used_application_count FROM t_res_base rbs WHERE rbs.rbs_id = #{resumeId} AND rbs.rbs_user_id = #{userId} AND rbs.rbs_status = 1
mapper.sql: SELECT app.app_id AS application_id, app.app_candidate_id AS candidate_id, app.app_position_id AS job_id, app.app_resume_id AS resume_id, pos.pos_title AS job_title, cmp.cmp_name AS company_name, cmp.cmp_logo_url AS company_logo_url, pos.pos_work_city AS location_text, pos.pos_salary_min AS salary_min, pos.pos_salary_max AS salary_max, rbs.rbs_resume_name AS resume_name, tal.tal_status AS status_code, app.app_matched_score AS matched_score, app.app_created_at AS applied_at, app.app_updated_at AS updated_at FROM t_app_record app INNER JOIN t_tal tal ON tal.tal_id = app.app_candidate_id INNER JOIN t_pos pos ON pos.pos_id = app.app_position_id INNER JOIN t_cmp cmp ON cmp.cmp_id = pos.pos_company_id LEFT JOIN t_res_base rbs ON rbs.rbs_id = app.app_resume_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_tal (tal_user_id, tal_company_id, tal_resume_id, tal_status, tal_current_round) VALUES (#{userId}, #{companyId}, #{resumeId}, 5, 0)
INSERT INTO t_app_record ( app_candidate_id, app_position_id, app_resume_id, app_matched_score, app_status ) VALUES ( #{candidateId}, #{jobId}, #{resumeId}, #{matchedScore}, 0 )
INSERT INTO t_tal_status_log ( tsl_candidate_id, tsl_from_status, tsl_to_status, tsl_reason, tsl_operator_id ) VALUES ( #{candidateId}, 0, 5, #{reason}, #{operatorId} )
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(tsl_to_status AS CHAR) AS stage, CASE WHEN tsl_to_status IN (3, 4, 8) THEN 'closed' WHEN tsl_to_status IN (2, 7) THEN 'current' WHEN tsl_to_status = 5 THEN 'processing' ELSE 'done' END AS state, CASE tsl_to_status WHEN 0 THEN '已投递' WHEN 1 THEN '初筛通过' WHEN 2 THEN '面试中' WHEN 3 THEN '未通过' WHEN 4 THEN '已录用' WHEN 5 THEN '企业初筛' WHEN 6 THEN '测评中' WHEN 7 THEN '待面试' WHEN 8 THEN '未通过' WHEN 9 THEN '流程结束' ELSE '投递进度' END AS title, tsl_reason AS description, tsl_created_at AS occurredAt FROM t_tal_status_log WHERE tsl_candidate_id = #{candidateId} ORDER BY tsl_created_at ASC, tsl_id ASC
